title: 真题演练 · 定语从句
hint: 本组题目按本单元语法点与词池生成/匹配;答错后点击「回溯语法课」复习 定语从句。

questions.q: The boy ___ is playing football is my brother.
questions.analysis: 指人且在从句中作主语,用 who。

questions.q: This is the school ___ I studied two years ago.
I like the book ___ covers are red.
questions.analysis: covers 属于 book,表示"…的"用 whose。

questions.q: The pen ___ I lost is on the desk.
questions.analysis: pen 是物,作 lost 的宾语,用 which。

questions.q: Do you know the man ___ is talking to Tom?
questions.analysis: 指人且在从句中作主语,用 who。

questions.q: 判断对错:The man which is standing there is my teacher.
questions.analysis: 应改为:The man who is standing there is my teacher.。指人用 who,不用 which。
